sections.text:
-Increases the activation priority of this Unison effect by 1.
-Target: all allies. Recovers 60% of max HP.
HP recovery boosted by 10% for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Activates Time Slice which reduces the time advantageous effects (buffs, special buffs, and non-removable buffs) are applied to the target by 30 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces fire, water, wind Unison damage Ability Power by 40 for 60 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces light, dark, time, and star Unison damage Ability Power by 40 for 60 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces all stats by 80% for 120 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Applies debuff removal resistance that blocks debuff removal, special debuff removal, or kismet 1 time.
-Target: all allies. Recovers 50 Cost.
-Target: all allies. Applies Awakening. (Activates for 60 seconds when HP reaches 60% or below.)
-Target: all allies. Applies frenzy (nullifies debuffs, nullifies status ailments, permits piercing through damage reduction and damage reflection) for 60 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Serenity for 90 seconds (increases max HP, DEF, and MDEF by 100%; nullifies debuffs and Cost reduction. After the effect ends, your character's Unison gauge is filled by 100).
Increases physical and magic Ability Power by 20 when equipped in the Main Slot.
